implementation_findings.surface_anchor_selection: 3 dominant-skin vertices per22 supported regions +1 head =67; foot regions selected low in native template; own selection differs from original SceneMI64 globalFPS
implementation_findings.cached_per_DDIM_call: global patch and dynamic-owner embeddings already cached together in sampling_scene
implementation_findings.proposal: no-grad estimated clean articulated body; never use GT body as query center
implementation_findings.IK_actual_defaults: 6 damped iterations; compact mode was previously disabled; full-model strict equivalence now failed, remains disabled
implementation_findings.physical_query_optional_pruning: energy uses9 CONTACT_JOINTS ->27 of67 anchors; optional subset query is numerically exact in tested full model, mixed timing so not selected
implementation_findings.physics_is_geometric: partial observed patches + pose/contact/velocity/prior energy with backtracking, not a rigid-body dynamics simulator
implementation_findings.training_quality: No architecture causal superiority or new gait convergence established; all current review optimization updates zero
